title: Topological analysis of permeability tensor in anisotropic porous media
abstract: arXiv:2611.29731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The permeability of an anisotropic porous medium is a tensor whose off-diagonal components, which describe the deflection of the macroscopic flux away from the driving force, are small and change sign under reflections. We ask whether direction-aware topological data analysis can predict the full permeability tensor of three-dimensional porous media directly from their geometry. We introduce two direction-aware topological descriptors for flow problems: a cone-based filtration, adapted from our earlier work on the elastic stiffness tensor, and a throat-scale filtration built on the distance transform of the pore space. Using permeability tensors computed with the lattice Boltzmann method, we compare them with a comprehensive set of non-topological baselines, comprising statistical microstructure descriptors and physics-based permeability estimators. translated_title: 各向异性多孔介质中渗透率张量的拓扑分析
translated_abstract: 各向异性多孔介质的渗透率是一个张量，其非对角分量描述了宏观通量相对于驱动力的偏转，这些分量很小且在反射变换下会改变符号。我们探讨方向感知的拓扑数据分析是否能够直接从三维多孔介质的几何结构预测其完整的渗透率张量。我们为流动问题引入了两个方向感知的拓扑描述符：一个是基于锥的过滤，改编自我们早期关于弹性刚度张量的工作；另一个是建立在孔隙空间距离变换之上的喉道尺度过滤。利用格子玻尔兹曼方法计算得到的渗透率张量，我们将这些拓扑描述符与一组全面的非拓扑基线方法进行比较，包括统计微观结构描述符和基于物理的渗透率估计器。拓扑描述符对于非对角分量最具信息量，而这些分量……
tldr: 本文提出两种方向感知的拓扑描述符（基于锥的过滤和喉道尺度过滤），证明拓扑数据分析可直接从三维多孔介质的几何结构预测其完整渗透率张量，且对描述通量偏转的非对角分量最具预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two direction-aware topological descriptors (a cone-based filtration and a throat-scale filtration) showing that topological data analysis can predict the full permeability tensor of 3D porous media directly from geometry, being most informative for the off-diagonal components describing flux deflection.
